summary: Adds a clean, minimal get_inlines() hook and routes get_inline_instances() through it, correctly resolving the issue without behavioral change to default usage. Mergeable; only minor convention nit on the signature default.

issues.description: get_inlines(self, request, obj) lacks the obj=None default used by sibling hooks (get_fieldsets, get_fields, get_ordering). Internally always called with obj so works, but inconsistent for subclasses calling it directly.
No docs update (ref/contrib/admin) for the new public hook; docstring is present but a maintainer would typically add release notes/docs.
